childcare.title: Daryeel Badbaado ah oo la Kormeero
childcare.description: Waxaan bixinnaa adeegyada daryeelka carruurta ee xirfadlayaasha ah inta lagu jiro dhacdooyinka shirka. Mutadawiciinteenna waa la baaray oo waay khibro u leeyihiin carruurta da'da kala duwan.

features.hours: Diyaar ah inta lagu jiro dhacdooyinka muhiimka ah ee shirka
features.location: Qol gaar ah oo daryeelka carruurta ah oo meesha ku yaal
features.advance: Soo dir codsasho 48+ saacadood ka hor

childcare.note: Si aad u codsato adeegyada daryeelka carruurta, booqo qaybta Adeegyada oo buuxi foomka codsashada daryeelka carruurta.

accessibility.title: Codso Caawimaad Helitaan
accessibility.description: Ma u baahan tahay caawimaad jireed, turjubaan ASL, ama turjubaan luuqad? Na ogolow inaan kaa caawino si khibradaada shirka loo heli karo.

childcare.title: Codso Adeegyada Daryeelka Carruurta
childcare.description: Ma u baahan tahay daryeelka carruurta inta lagu jiro dhacdooyinka shirka? Soo dir codsasho oo waxaan kaa caawin doonnaa in aan daryeel badbaado ah oo la kormeero carruurta loogu diyaariyo.

volunteer.title: Iskaa Wax U Qabso Shirka
volunteer.description: Ka caawi in ICYPAA dhacdo! Isdiiwaangeli soo dhaweynta, dejinta, nadiifinta, ama fursado kale oo adeeg ah.

hospitality.title: Cusboonaysiinta Soo dhaweynta
hospitality.description: Dhammaan u sheeg markaad keenayso cunto ama alaabta qolka soo dhaweynta!

support.title: Wada sheekaysi Taageero
support.description: Ma caawimaad baahan tahay? Bilow wada sheekaysi kooxdeenna taageerada.

info.title: Adeegyada Daryeelka Carruurta
info.description: Waxaan bixinnaa daryeel badbaado ah oo la kormeero inta lagu jiro dhacdooyinka shirka. Mutadawiciinteenna waa la baaray oo waay khibro u leeyihiin carruurta. Fadlan soo dir codsashadaada ugu yaraan 48 saacadood ka hor.

placeholders.specialNeeds: Wax kasta oo xasaasiyad, baahiyaha caafimaadka, tixgalinta dabeecadda, iwm.
placeholders.additionalInfo: Macluumaad kale oo aan ogaan lahayn...

success.title: Codsashada la Soo Diray
success.message: Codsashadaada daryeelka carruurta waa la soo diray. Waxaan kula xidhiidhi doonnaa 24 saacadood gudahood xaqiijin iyo faahfaahin.

error.title: Khalad
error.message: Soo dirista codsashada way fashilantay. Fadlan isku day mar kale.
error.required: Fadlan buuxi dhammaan goobaha loo baahan yahay.
